title: Firinda Tavuk
subtitle: Turkish roasted chicken thighs with paprika and lemon
excerpt: Bone-in chicken thighs marinated in yoghurt, paprika, garlic and lemon, then roasted until the skin is deep red and crisp. A straightforward Turkish oven chicken that needs very little effort.
sourceNotes: Turkish home cooking; firinda means oven-baked; paprika and yoghurt marinade is the classic approach.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Marinate overnight in the fridge for a deeper flavour and more tender meat.

content.text: Firinda tavuk is Turkish baked chicken marinated in spiced yoghurt before roasting. The yoghurt tenderises the meat and helps the skin colour deeply in the oven. Marinate for at least one hour, but overnight gives the best result.
Mix the yoghurt, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and zest, both paprikas, cumin, oregano, salt and pepper together in a large bowl.
Score each chicken thigh 2 or 3 times through the skin to the bone. Add them to the marinade and turn to coat well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 200C. Lift the chicken from the marinade and place skin-side up in a single layer in a roasting tin. Spoon any remaining marinade over the top.
Roast for 45 to 50 minutes. The skin should be deep red and starting to crisp at the edges. The juices should run clear when the thickest part is pierced.
Rest the chicken in the tin for 5 minutes before serving. Serve with lemon wedges alongside.

items.symptom: The skin does not crisp and stays pale.
items.cause: Too much marinade was left on the skin, or the oven was not hot enough.
items.fix: Wipe excess marinade off the skin before roasting. Make sure the oven is fully at temperature before the chicken goes in.

items.symptom: The marinade burns on the tin before the chicken is cooked.
items.cause: The tin is too small and the marinade pools thickly around the base.
items.fix: Use a wider tin so the liquid spreads thinly. Add a splash of water to the base if it starts to catch.

items.cause: The chicken was overcooked, or the thighs were too small.
items.fix: Check at 40 minutes. Thighs are done when the juices run clear. Remove from the oven as soon as they are ready.
